what: A big mark piece from the logo split in two floats fixed at the top left and bottom right corners of the screen (28rem, phone 10rem), and the same set is shown only inside each section’s clip, so on scroll the mark color changes at the section boundary to that section’s color (white on dark photo sections, slightly lighter than the background on gray sections, slightly darker on charcoal sections) — scroll is the boundary, so there is no curve

duration.Scroll: The moment of crossing a section boundary

options.look: light: Marker slightly lighter than the background (gray background section) — kf-surface 35% · kf-bg
options.look: dark: Mark slightly darker than the contrast panel (charcoal panel section) — kf-ink 50% · kf-contrast-bg
options.look: ink: Contrast text color marker (dark photo section)
options.--fx-size-narrow: Piece width at 767px or below, default 10rem
options.--fx-nudge: Distance to push pieces off-screen, default .6rem
options.[data-fx-part=corner][data-key=start|end: Piece cell — start is top left, end is bottom right. One svg inside (the end piece uses the same art rotated 180°)

use: …Section content…

from.where: shared.js .jl-mark inserted per section via [data-mark] (original c-mark — each section has a clip-path: inset(0) panel holding two position: fixed pieces, colors per section white·#ededed·#1f1f1f, width 28rem, .6rem off-screen)

note: The section (parent) must have position. clip-path also clips fixed children, so they are not visible outside the section. If you put transform on the section, the fixed reference becomes the section and the child will not stick to the corner, so do not put transform on the section.
